12652: Window-event focus recovery for an already active lock surface; separate from #12435's logind monitor and #9181's resume/PAM retry ownership. Preserve as a follow-up; not stacked into accepted fingerprint work.
12614: Closed in favor of #12652 to correct commit attribution; preserve the original source and exact production comparison.
12667: Shared lock numeric-keypad handling with an attributed Apple Magic Keyboard report. Separate from T1 provider and fingerprint lifecycle; retained as follow-up context, not a new prerequisite.
7146: Complete clamshell-overlay proposal replaces its former parser, changes external-active truth/unknown handling and modifies the watcher shared with P05. Retain separately; it is not the accepted P04 lid-lock component or P05 filtering patch.
9181: Broader FocusScope/focus-generation recovery changes the sleep monitor, explicit resume IPC and post-PAM retry policy. Preserve separately from #12652 and #12435; no mixed focus ownership is invented.
10141: Existing MacBookPro13,3 bundle combines separate calibration, legacy T1/SPI, NVMe and experimental Radeon work. Retain relevant device reports and model boundaries; this roll-up does not cover or endorse the full bundle.
